note: Dune outlines from NASADEM (SRTM, Feb 2000), kept only where NASADEM resolves the dune (DEM shading matches the 2000-11-27 Landsat image; crest >= 5.8 m above its surroundings = 3 x DEM noise). Positions moved to 2025-11-08 by the measured Landsat 8/9 2013-2025 velocity. Motion below the detection limit: below_detection_limit = true, speed_med_myr = 0, speed_lo_myr = 0, speed_hi_myr = detection limit, heading_deg = null, wind_agreement_deg = null (no direction can be measured). Classes are relative to this field: stable = below detection limit, slow < 0.65, active < 1.15, fast >= 1.15 m/yr. Smaller dunes are not outlined; their motion is in vectors.geojson. Computed by pipeline/02_tracking_and_dunes.ipynb. Threat fields computed by pipeline/03_threats_and_frames.ipynb (see threat_definition).
